'''Jerell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. Jerell survived the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of his homeworld]] and went on to become a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], Jerell had become a personal aide to Rebel [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vanden Huyck Willard|Vanden Willard]]. During this time, he accompanied the general aboard the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Gamble]]'' on a mission to acquire supplies for the construction of [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
